app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: Transient unavailability of the recommendation service: the recommendation container repeatedly crashed (Last State: Terminated with Exit Code 2) and entered BackOff, so frontend gRPC calls to recommendation were canceled and returned HTTP 500. args.root_cause: Transient unavailability of the recommendation service: the recommendation container repeatedly crashed (Last State: Terminated with Exit Code 2) and entered BackOff, so frontend gRPC calls to recommendation were canceled and returned HTTP 500. Concretely: recommendation-6879fb56bf-mqnc6 shows Restart Count: 2, Last State Terminated (Exit Code: 2) and a BackOff event; a frontend trace for the failing request shows the client span to /recommendation.Recommendation/GetRecommendations recorded "rpc error: code = Canceled desc = context canceled" and the frontend HTTP span returned status 500.
args.evidence_summary:
1) Cluster overview: 19 pods and 20 services found in namespace test-hotel-reservation; several app pods show restart counts (profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, user).
2) kubectl get pods (wide) shows recommendation-6879fb56bf-mqnc6 Restart Count: 2.
3) kubectl describe pod recommendation-6879fb56bf-mqnc6: Last State: Terminated, Reason: Error, Exit Code: 2; Events include Warning BackOff restarting failed container.
4) recommendation pod logs show startup (DB init, "Successfully registered in consul") but the pod still had earlier termination and restarts.
5) A frontend trace (traceID 510b366441679cce) shows a client gRPC span to /recommendation.Recommendation/GetRecommendations with tag response_code=Canceled and an error log "rpc error: code = Canceled desc = context canceled"; the frontend HTTP span for the same request returned http.status_code=500.
6) Frontend logs show it initialized gRPC clients for srv-recommendation but the traces show the calls were canceled.
These facts indicate the recommendation service was intermittently unavailable at the time of frontend requests, causing cancellations and 500s.
args.investigation_summary: I inspected cluster state and logs for the test-hotel-reservation namespace, focused on the frontend trace entry point and the recommendation service (which traces implicated). I listed pods/services, looked at frontend traces (only errors) and a failing trace, and examined recommendation pod describe and logs. The trace shows frontend gRPC calls to recommendation were canceled; the recommendation pod had recent container terminations (Exit Code 2) and BackOff events. The evidence points to transient crashes of the recommendation container during startup/early runtime which caused the frontend errors.
